HOW TO PLAY
Everyone brings one wrapped gift (agree on a price first) and draws a number ticket. Pile the gifts in the middle.
Classic Steal (no dice needed)
1. Number 1 opens a gift from the pile.
2. Each next player opens a new gift or steals an opened one.
3. If your gift is stolen, open a new gift or steal another. No stealing straight back.
4. A gift is frozen after its third steal.
5. When the pile is gone, number 1 may make one last swap.
One Die (quick and lively)
1. In ticket order, everyone takes a gift from the pile and opens it.
2. Set a timer for 10 minutes.
3. Take turns rolling one die and do what the chart says.
4. When the timer ends, keep the gift you are holding.
Two Dice (big groups and longer play)
1. In ticket order, everyone takes a gift from the pile and opens it.
2. Take turns rolling two dice. Add them up and check the chart.
3. Play 3 rounds, or until the timer ends.
4. A frozen gift can't move until its holder's next turn.

Your download is 1 ZIP file, "white-elephant-game.zip". Inside it are 3 files:

Every guest brings 1 wrapped gift. Turn Number Slips are 32 slips on 4 pages, so each player draws a number and writes a name on it. Player 1 opens any gift. Each later player either opens a new gift or steals one that is already open. After a gift is stolen 3 times it is locked and stays with its new owner.

White Elephant Action Cards are 32 cards on 5 pages. Cut them apart, fold each one and drop them in a bowl. After you open or steal a gift, draw a card from the bowl, read it out loud, do what it says and set it aside.

The Gift Exchange Tracker is 1 page with 16 rows, one for each turn: who played, which gift was opened, who it was stolen from and how many steals it has.
